review_cost.rationale: Approve-with-changes: the asks are mechanical (not-found refactor, dedupe card loops, dead code, split the data module) rather than architectural, but together they are a real round of review.

findings.issue: Not-found is handled by a catch-all splat route plus per-loader {notFound:true} unions with `if (data.notFound)` in five page components, instead of the framework's notFound()/notFoundComponent; unmatched URLs and unknown resources respond with HTTP 200 and the pattern is duplicated in every detail route.
findings.suggestion: Throw notFound() in the loaders (or beforeLoad) and put one notFoundComponent on the root route; Start will then render it and emit a real 404 status, and the discriminated unions disappear from every page type.

findings.issue: getPokemonPageData fires one parallel getMove fetch per unique move of the selected game (often 100+ requests) plus one version-group fetch per game, so the first visit to a Pokémon page hammers the upstream API and is slow.
findings.suggestion: Batch with a small concurrency limit (e.g. p-limit of 8-16) and/or pre-warm the move cache; the module-level cache already covers repeat visits.

findings.issue: A single 777-line data.server.ts owns the API client, every record type and the page-data assembly for all six routes, so every future feature touches one file.
findings.suggestion: Split per resource (api.ts for the client, and move/movePageData.ts, pokemon/pokemonPageData.ts, etc.), keeping the existing type-only client surface.

findings.issue: Three near-identical 'exclude forms >10000, dedupe, resolve species, sort by dex' loops are duplicated in getMovePageData, getAbilityPageData and getTypePageData (629-642, 672-684, 744-756).
findings.suggestion: Extract a buildSpeciesCards(refs) helper used by all three.

findings.issue: Broad catch blocks silently degrade content (missing move tables, fallback sprite, single-species evolution) with no logging, so an API outage looks like empty sections.
findings.suggestion: At minimum log the error and surface a user-visible degradation; consider an errorComponent on the root route for hard failures.

findings.issue: Four dead exported helpers (trackable, formatHeight, formatWeight, compareText); the height/weight formatting they would own is instead inlined at data.server.ts:536-537.
findings.suggestion: Delete the dead exports and use formatHeight/formatWeight at the call site, or drop them entirely.

findings.issue: Identity validators (.validator((d) => d)) provide type-level plumbing but no runtime validation of client-supplied input to server functions.
findings.suggestion: Validate with a schema library (zod/valibot) as the docs recommend, or remove the validator and rely on typed params/deps.

findings.issue: typeLabel() mutates the Map passed in by the caller, a hidden side effect on state the caller may expect to be read-only.
findings.suggestion: Have it return the label and let the caller update the map, or make the cache explicit.

findings.issue: `evolution-chain/${idFromUrl(url) ?? ''}` builds an invalid request path if the URL doesn't parse, relying on the surrounding catch to hide it.
findings.suggestion: Guard idFromUrl and skip the evolution fetch when it returns null.

findings.issue: An eslint-disable comment for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps exists, but there is no ESLint config or lint script in app/package.json, so the suppressions are dead weight and the rule never actually ran.
findings.suggestion: Add an ESLint setup (flat config with react-hooks) or drop the disable comment; restructure deps so the rule is satisfied.

summary: This is a competently built, current-idiom TanStack Start app: router, root document, server functions and loaders all match the framework's own docs, and no correctness landmines turned up. The main review objections are the bespoke not-found mechanism (catch-all route plus per-route unions instead of notFound()/notFoundComponent, which also forfeits the 404 status) and a 777-line god data module with duplicated card-building loops. I'd approve after one mechanical round: not-found refactor, split/dedupe the data layer, and delete the dead format helpers.
